data.title: Merge Obfuscation (formerly "Anonymization") of Reporters into Core
data.body:
### Requirements:
- [x] User can configure Hide Location per Survey
- [x] User can configure Hide Author Information per Survey
- [x] User can configure Hide Date/time per Survey
- [x] User can set a global value for the precision of locations when using Hide Location
- [x] When Hide Location is enabled, location will be only precise to a certain number of decimal places
- [x] When Author Information is hidden, the author information will not be returned from the API
- [x] When the Date/Time is hidden, the author information will not be returned from the API

### Acceptance Criteria: Site Settings
- [x] User can edit and save the precision level for hide location
- [x] When the user changes the value of the precision level the text showing the precision in terms of kilometres is updated

### Acceptance Criteria:  Survey Config
- [x] When creating/editing a Survey the User has the option to set:
  - [x] Hide Author Information
  - [x] Hide Date time
  - [x] Hide location
- [x] When Hide location is enabled for a survey, the locations should only be precise to the degree set by the global precision level under site settings
- [x] When Hide Author is enabled, the Post should display without the author information when viewing a post
- [x] When Hide Date is enabled, the Post should display without the exact time when viewing a post, it should be set to midnight of the day the post was created.

### Acceptance Criteria: Data View
- With anonymization set, go to data view
- In another tab, create a new post 
- [x] in original tab, the "1 new post" button should appear at the top of data view list
-------
- filter the list so that at least the top most post is filtered out
- [x] wait 60 seconds and confirm that the "1 new post" button does NOT appear at the top of the list
--------
- select a post mid-way down the list of posts, then refresh
- [x] the selected post should be at the top of the list
- [x] wait 60 seconds and confirm that the "new posts" button does NOT appear at the top of the list
--------
- select a post
- select a filter that will filter out the selected post
- [x] the list should refresh and the top-most post should be selected from the list
---------
- filter the list so that 0 posts match
- in another tab/window, create a new post so that it does match the filters 
- [x] back in the first tab, confirm that the new post button appears 

**How it should work?**

- Information needs to be stored in full detail in the database (just as usual)
- That’s because it needs to remain accessible to privileged users (i.e. admins)
- Users without the right privileges get anonymised data


This is tied to survey definitions and role and permissions system
- Surveys have settings for hiding information to be anonymised , by data type (i.e. "Hide exact location information")
- The "Manage posts" permission grants access to bypass the settings and see exact, non-anonymised information

The "Edit any posts" permission still allows to edit any posts, but it doesn't imply being able to access the exact, non-anonymised information.
- This allows creating a role of "unprivileged editors", who can edit non-anonymised data from posts, but still can't see (or edit) the anonymised data.


**Complications to current method**
The "unprivileged editors" role mentioned above should have a clear indication that there are fields they cannot edit.

What happens when an unprivileged editor sends an update for a post with anonymised fields.. is just that the API silently ignores any changes to the anonymised fields.


**What needs to be anonymised**
- Author information
- There is a current feature that allows hiding the author of the post, if enabled for the form. We don't need to expand on it.
- Datetime fields (metadata and custom)
- In general the client would like to drop times and leave the dates
- Times are rounded up to the top of the hour

**Location fields**
Adjust points to a grid of coarser resolution (i.e. 200m x 200m) with Circle Area instead of point on a map

**What needs to be tested**
That the anonymisation is effective:

- [x] GET /api/v3/posts
- [x] GET /api/v3/geojson
- [x] CSV download
- [x] post alerts / notifications
- [x] Web and mobile clients not breaking when we don’t send some data that could be expected

Work on this issue has been done by @rjmackay in another repo, but needs to be tested to merge
